extraction: First row (zero-based row 0) of each of the three EIS CSV files was transcribed from the web tool raw-text view. It was NOT downloaded as a full original binary. make_input.py preserves all three transcribed vectors.
retained_input: one cell; all 70 listed frequencies; original imaginary signs; Hz and Ohm
source_hash_validation: Full upstream CSV MD5 hashes were not independently verified, because full downloads failed. The retained local CSV has a SHA256 digest in runtime.json and MANIFEST.json.
pulse_validation: Unperformed. Pulse files were located and initial raw rows viewed, but a complete time/current/voltage trace and absolute pulse-current contract were not recovered into the executable environment.
other_information_not_used: Other 91 cells, pseudo-open-circuit voltage curves, full pulse traces, current/capacity calibration, and broader nonlinear/temperature-dependent models.
statistical_error: No calibrated covariance or replicated noise model was acquired. The 0.1 mOhm per-component budget is an exploratory deterministic assumption, not a confidence interval.

baseline_code_inspected.scope: Original fitting core and prediction API snippets inspected; full package not executed.

research_memory_context.use: Repository orientation and stated claim-status policies inspected. No result from either repository is a load-bearing theorem in this package. No comprehensive repository audit was performed.
